## My request:
시각 의미 데이터와 후보 데이터에 반영해줘. 그 다음 스킬의 최신 버전을 사용하여 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 이번에 반영한 주제가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.
interpreted_intent: The requester asks for independent complex random concepts that actually test the newly integrated winter-fashion topic, using the supplied reference. The contextual antecedent of 이번에 반영한 주제 is winter fashion. Face and hair take appearance guidance only; exact same-person identity is not promised. My agent-owned seed selected a ferry threshold after a snow squall: a woman pauses over a crate of greenhouse cuttings and notices the relit boarding lamp. The coat structure, its closure and attached pile trim, and the distinct interior vest and sweater carry the winter-fashion test. The cold arrival traces, waiting stance and open gate make a small practical transition legible. Her easy warmth, tactile winter clothing and relaxed lips supply subtle everyday attraction at sensual 1; fetish 0 and surreal 0 add no treatment, and creativity 1 keeps the invention close to an ordinary winter setting. I prefer this practical threshold scene to an isolated garment display because the cold and the pause give the layering a visible purpose. All invented staging and garment details remain agent choices.
subject: A woman portrayed with visible face and hair guidance from the supplied reference photograph.
setting: Sheltered coastal ferry boarding threshold after a snow squall at blue dusk.
event: Winter clothing is visibly readable as the woman waits beside a supported crate and lifts her gaze toward the boarding lamp.
visual_priorities: The face and bob carry a softly alert presence as her gaze follows the boarding lamp.
The coat fronts meet at one toggle-and-loop closure while the open lower front exposes the separate quilted vest and roll-neck sweater.
Cream pile borders remain attached to the hood and cuffs of the same navy outer coat.
The hand, crate and ledge form a supported practical pause; snow traces and an open gate connect arrival to the next departure.
baseline_prompt_en: Create a photographic winter fashion portrait of a woman in winter clothing at a sheltered ferry boarding threshold after a coastal snow squall. Her visible face and hair follow the supplied image as appearance guidance. Her dark chin-length bob and wispy bangs frame a softly alert face; she lifts her eyes toward the newly illuminated amber boarding lamp, lips relaxing slightly after the wait. Her winter clothing is visibly readable in one continuous figure. She wears a navy wool duffle coat reaching just above the knees. Its generous hood rests behind her head; dense cream pile is sewn around the hood's opening and around each sleeve cuff, with a clear navy fabric border connecting every strip to the coat. Three horizontal wooden toggles and their thick rope loops sit on opposite front edges. The upper toggle is threaded across the rope loop to connect the two coat fronts; the two lower toggles hang beside their unfastened loops. The open lower front reveals a separate ochre sleeveless quilted vest with large diamond-stitched cells, its own narrow front edges and hem. Beneath the vest is a cream ribbed roll-neck sweater; its ribbed tube folds over into a high collar around her neck, while the sweater fabric at her waist continues below the vest's hem. The coat sleeve is visibly outside the cream knit sleeve at each wrist. These are three independently bounded garments with readable boundaries and a practical winter silhouette. A low cedar crate of wrapped greenhouse cuttings sits on a waist-high luggage ledge at her left. Her left hand rests on the crate's near rim while the crate's base is supported by the ledge; her right arm hangs clear of the coat front, with the relaxed hand beside her thigh. Both feet stand apart on the flat sheltered threshold, torso upright and slightly turned toward the water, shoulders lowered. The amber lamp and an open boarding gate give her raised gaze a destination. Snow still clings to the crate's lid and outside railing; a meltwater track ends at her boots, marking where she just arrived. Beyond the gate, the ferry's warm entry window glows through blue dusk. Photograph from mid-chest height in a near-frontal three-quarter view, including her head, both wrists, coat hem, crate and boots in a vertical frame. The face is the first point of attention, followed by the distinct winter layers and closures; the crate and boarding lamp complete the pause. Cold diffuse sky light retains navy wool texture, rope fibers, stitched quilting and individual cream pile fibers. A gentle warm spill from the terminal door touches her cheek and hand. The natural perspective and moderate depth preserve both the garment mechanisms and the small threshold story. Her composed warmth and tactile clothes create a quiet everyday attraction within the observed moment.
